note: The field year. The tutorial page https://www.quartz-scheduler.org/documentation/quartz-2.3.0/tutorials/crontrigger.html allows 1970 to 2099, the API page https://www.quartz-scheduler.org/api/2.3.0/org/quartz/CronExpression.html 1970 to 2199, both read 2026-11-19. The source file quartz-core/src/main/java/org/quartz/CronExpression.java of https://github.com/quartz-scheduler/quartz at tag v2.3.2, the same file as at tag quartz-2.3.0 (read 2026-11-19) accepts any year at lines 966 to 999 and ends a search after the year the class is loaded plus 100 (lines 257, 1054 to 1060 and 1513 to 1517). This parser takes 1970 to 2199 as fixed bounds. Instants are UTC. Each instant of next is the first one strictly after the one before it, the first strictly after from; none means that no instant follows up to the end of the year 2199. The instants were computed by a brute force walk over the days and the times of the sets, written apart from the package.
